philosophers_grand_banquet: The apex of dungeon cuisine: chimera heart and dragon scale plated atop the rendered essence of a lich's own phylactery. Edible flowers crown a meal most cooks die attempting.
goblin_rat_stew: A battered tin pot of stringy goblin and stringier rat, simmered together until the grease floats in a thick gold film. Crude camp food, but it stays with you.
serpent_frog_bisque: Snake flesh and frog legs pureed into a pale, creamy bisque the color of pond water. A coiled garnish gives it a sly, fenland elegance.
bat_rat_soup: A muddy cave-broth of rat and bat, smelling faintly of guano and iron. Trogs and tomb-robbers swear by it; everyone else holds their nose and swallows.
chitin_bone_crisps: Insect plates and shards of bone roasted until they shatter sweetly under the tooth. A crackling, unsettling little dish that eats like brittle peanut brittle gone wrong.
goblin_bone_pottage: A pottage of goblin meat and marrow-cracked bone, plated like real cuisine in defiance of its source. Earthy, grimy, and undeniably warming to the bones.
spider_silk_jelly: Spider silk dissolved into a quivering aspic studded with eye-jelly cubes. The silk gives it an unnerving spring; the eyes watch you eat them.
orc_bat_broth: Orcish blood thinned with cave-bat into a smooth verdant broth. Tastes coppery and feral, like a war drum simmered down to liquid.
gnoll_lion_ragout: Gnoll shank and lion meat braised together until the two predators surrender into one russet gravy. Savage on the plate, gentle in the mouth.
death_knight_broth: A funerary broth of charred bone and zombie flesh, black as wet ash and twice as silent. It drinks like cold iron and lingers like a held breath.
hobgoblin_orc_stew: A regimental stew of mixed greenskin blood thickened over a long fire, the way orcish quartermasters do it in the field. Brutish, hot, and effective.
lizard_frog_ragout: Lizard and frog stewed together in a swampy green sauce. Light and springing on the tongue, the kind of dish that makes you quicker on your feet by lunch.
bear_troll_haunch: A glistening haunch of bear roasted with troll hide woven through it like marbling. The troll meat keeps weeping back together until the salt finally sets it.
hobgoblin_ogre_feast: A warlord's spread of hobgoblin blood reduced with ogre hide and laid out on a banquet platter. Eat it before a campaign and your shoulders feel wider.
spectral_eye_consomme: A pale violet consomme clarified through spectral essence until the broth itself seems to hover above the bowl. Each spoonful sharpens the inner eye.
shadow_crystal_broth: Shadow essence steeped around a chip of black crystal until the broth swallows its own light. Drink it and the room forgets exactly where you were standing.
wisp_soul_risotto: A pale risotto suspended in wisp-light, every grain holding a fragment of soul. It glows on the spoon and answers questions you forgot you were asking.
bugbear_troll_roast: Bugbear pelt and troll hide spit-roasted back to back, the bugbear meat smoky, the troll meat threatening to knit shut. Brute food, plated for a chieftain.
spider_phase_silk_dish: Noodles of ordinary spider silk braided with phase silk, served before they slip out of this layer of reality. The first bite is here; the second tasted of somewhere else.
demon_heart_roast: A glistening roast carved from a nalfeshnee's heart and basted with hezrou bile. The fat hisses on the platter in a language no cook should learn.
elder_vampire_phylactery_elixir: Elder vampire blood distilled together with a necromancer's phylactery into a single shimmering russet draught. An ugly union, beautifully bottled.
cerebral_eye_pudding: Cerebral fluid set with eye-jelly into a trembling grey pudding that thinks faintly at the diner. Refined mind flayer fare, served cold.
death_essence_soul_stew: An earthy stew of distilled death essence and tethered soul fragments, simmered until the bowl hums on its own. Funeral food for those who plan to return.
troll_ogre_regeneration_broth: A verdant broth pulled from a troll's regeneration gland and an ogre's tough hide. It knits the diner shut as quickly as the troll healed in life.
dragon_fire_gland_elixir: Dragon scale dissolved in melted fire-gland and decanted into a glass flask that radiates heat. A sip of liquid wyrmfire, cellared into elegance.
chaos_void_brew: Chaos essence stirred against a void shard until the plate stops agreeing with itself. Every bite is a different dish; every diner becomes someone slightly new.
cultist_arcane_tincture: A dark tincture of cultist reagent ground with arcane bone dust, drunk in a single bitter swallow. Tastes like chalk and forbidden books.
changeling_puca_illusion_soup: A pale violet broth that wears a different face from every angle of the bowl. Changeling glamour and puca hair conspire to unstitch you from sight.
drow_venom_tincture: Drow poison extract neutralized with paralytic venom into a cold, mineral tincture. The hand that pours it stays steady; the hand that drinks it gets steadier.
basilisk_medusa_grand_feast: A grand platter of basilisk eye and medusa blood, plated with edible flowers in defiance of their petrifying source. To eat it is to stare back.
chimera_dragon_roast: Chimera heart and dragon scale roasted together over coals that refuse to die. The platter hisses in three voices and the meal lands in every stat at once.
lich_vampire_death_banquet: An undying banquet of necromancer phylactery and elder vampire blood, the two great refusals of death plated side by side. Each course makes the next less final.
devourer_soul_judges_feast: A funerary platter of devourer tooth and bound soul fragments, plated as if for judgement. Eat in silence; the dish keeps its own balance.
pit_fiend_void_supremacy: Pit fiend scale glazed with void ichor and plated with infernal precision. The plate is hot under the hand and colder than the abyss beneath the food.
troll_demon_brain_undying: Troll regeneration gland folded into demon heart and bound with death essence. A formula, not a meal: three refusals of dying eaten in one sitting.
shadow_bat_stew: A thick dark stew of shadow fur and bat wing, the steam unwilling to rise straight. Two bowls in, the cook's apprentice cannot remember serving you.
grub_goblin_bake: Insect carapace and goblin flesh baked under a hard crust until the whole thing crackles open like roadside roast. Filling in a way no one wants to think about.
lycan_troll_broth: Lycanthrope blood and troll hide rendered together into a russet broth that smells of wet pelt and forest. It growls quietly on the way down.
raven_eagle_consomme: A dark, clarified consomme drawn from raven and eagle feathers, sharp with sky and altitude. The sight clears almost before the first spoon finishes.
naga_python_scales: Naga and python scales braised tender and plated like roof tiles, glazed in their own oils. Supple to chew, suppler still in the legs afterward.
owlbear_griffin_feast: Owlbear and griffin feathers crowning a platter built like a hunt-trophy. The kitchen reeks of woodsmoke and beak; the diner leaves wider in the shoulder.
barrow_embalming_stew: A russet stew of barrow dust and embalming resin, sweet and bituminous in alternating spoonfuls. Tomb-keepers cook it to teach their bodies how to last.
wisp_shadow_brew: Wisp essence and shadow essence whisked into a brew the color of late dusk. Drink it between the lamp going out and the candle catching, and the mind sits cleaner.
orc_bugbear_conquest: Orc blood thickened with bugbear pelt into a marching-pottage the conqueror's kitchen perfected over generations. It feeds the arm before it feeds the heart.
abyssal_fenrir_roast: Fenrir's fang spitted with dragon scale and crusted with void salt, served on a wooden platter that smolders quietly at the corners. Wolf-meat for the end of the world.
void_destroyer_feast: A banquet platter of void essence, dragon scale, and chimera heart, arranged with the calm of a verdict. Each bite undoes a small piece of whatever you used to be.
destroyers_arcane_essence: Void essence bound to a necromancer's phylactery and crystallized with void salt. The diner wears the meal's protection like a held breath.
death_march_reduction: Fenrir's fang reduced down with void essence until almost nothing remains except weight. A single spoon of it walks you another mile past the end.
rat_dragon_paradox: Rat meat simmered with dragon scale and a pinch of void salt, the cheapest and the costliest ingredient meeting in one warm bowl. The paradox sits well in the stomach.
fire_ice_transcendence: Fire gland, frost gland, manticore spine, and dragon scale plated together as a single hush of contradicting heat. The first bite burns; the second freezes; the third forgets both.
first_and_last: Rat meat, void essence, and void salt: the humblest harvest and the final ingredients, laid out on one plate. Alpha and omega, served warm.
bone_of_ages: Bone shard, hero's bone, and necromancer phylactery ground and recombined into a single cold, intelligent dish. It tastes of libraries and grave dust.
alchemists_base: Slime core, basilisk stone, chimera heart, and medusa blood beaten together into the foundation stock every great alchemist eventually attempts. A meal that doubles as a thesis.
